title: Make Number Of Distinct Characters Equal
statement:
Given lowercase strings `word1` and `word2`, choose one character from each and swap them. Return whether it is possible for the two resulting strings to have the same number of distinct characters.

## Examples

```text
Input: word1 = "ac", word2 = "b"
Output: false
```

```text
Input: word1 = "abcc", word2 = "aab"
Output: true
```

```text
Input: word1 = "abcde", word2 = "fghij"
Output: true
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= word1.length, word2.length <= 10^5`
- Both strings contain lowercase English letters.
